search_kagi: search the Kagi Search API for a query and return structured SearchResult objects
filter_kagi_results: filter Kagi search results by a list of allowed domains or keywords
authenticate_kagi_api: authenticate Kagi API requests using a Bot token in the Authorization header
parse_kagi_search_response: parse Kagi API JSON response and extract url, title, and snippet fields
limit_kagi_search_results: limit the number of Kagi search results returned via the limit parameter
